styleTemplate: Match the rendering of the attached reference exactly: simple flat vector shapes with only soft two-tone linear gradients, no texture, no fur strands, no realistic lighting, no outlines, minimal detail, cute sticker-like mascot. Chibi proportions: head about 45% of the body height, small body, short legs. Large glossy hard hat with one white highlight stripe{BADGE}. Big dark round eyes with white highlights, pink blush ovals on cheeks, tiny smiling mouth. Yellow high-visibility vest with two white reflective stripes and a zipper, brown belt with a square buckle, dark navy trousers, brown boots. The hard hat and the badge are fully opaque solid colors, never transparent or see-through. Centered full-body character, standing, facing the viewer, transparent background, absolutely no shadow and no ground under the feet, no other text.
badge: and a small white round badge with dark blue letters BI
recolorTemplate: Change ONLY the color of the hard hat to {COLOR_NAME} ({HEX}) keeping the same white highlight stripe. Keep absolutely everything else identical: same character, pose, proportions, vest, props, colors, badge, framing and transparent background. No shadow, no ground.
